szoveg_eredeti: Another favorite Teammate use case for me: when headhunters hit you up with candidate profiles without revealing the name but a description of what they’ve done. I have a Teammate that just uses Perplexity’s people-search-sdk to figure out who that is, score and filter for potential needs internally, and draft an outbound for me to reach out to them, removing the middleman. Works with 100% accuracy.
